tooltips.forgermod.ability.delusion.name: Delusion
tooltips.forgermod.ability.delusion: Arm your next successful melee hit on a mob for up to 30 seconds. That mob forgets its aggression and cannot acquire an attack target for 20 seconds. It may still wander. Switching cancels the effect. Cooldown after ending: 40/35/30/25 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.delusion.card: Your next mob hit makes it forget aggression for 20 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.false_awakeni: Mark an aimed enemy within 20 blocks with alternating real/echo silhouettes. A shadowless violet echo distracts visible hostile mobs within 8 blocks. Your next successful melee hit on the real target deals 10/15/20/25% more damage and ends the dream. Duration: 4/5/6/7 seconds; cooldown: 30/25/20/15 seconds.
Distract enemies with an echo; strike the real target for a bonus.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.overwhelming_: Melee hits that are successfully shield-blocked break that shield. Deal 20% extra armor durability damage, carrying fractional wear between hits. Mobs use the same vanilla armor-wear baseline for this bonus. Maximum level: I.
Break blocking shields and add 20% armor wear.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.null_receipt: Negate knockback from the next five damaging hits and store the canceled force, up to 5. Release it as extra knockback with your next vertical axe slam. Lasts up to 30 seconds; switching cancels it. Cooldown after release/end: 40/35/30/25 seconds.
Store knockback from five hits; release it in a vertical slam.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.distance_tax: A successful hit marks one enemy for 10 seconds. Then its distance from you deals 0.5/0.75/1/1.25 damage per block at levels I/II/III/IV, capped at 40 damage. Repeated hits keep the deadline; another enemy replaces the mark. Switching cancels it.
Mark an enemy, then move away before the ten-second tax.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.echoing_speed: Successful hits on the same enemy each add 5% attack speed, capped at 20/30/40/50% at levels I/II/III/IV. A different target resets buildup. Eight seconds without a hit, switching weapons or the target dying clears it.
Build attack speed with repeated hits on one enemy.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.death_stare: Teleport beside the mob directly under your crosshair. Range: 30/60/120 blocks at levels I/II/III; level IV reaches any loaded, visible distance. Walls block targeting and occupied destinations are rejected. Cooldown: 45/40/35/30 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.death_stare.c: Teleport beside the mob directly under your crosshair.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.swing_attack: Swing around, dealing current weapon damage to every visible enemy within your current melee range. Cooldown: 30/25/20/15 seconds at levels I/II/III/IV.
Strike every visible enemy in your melee range.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.strong_arm: Attempt to break one random armor piece on the enemy you aim at within melee range. Chance: 30/55/80/100% at levels I/II/III/IV. A valid attempt starts a 60/50/40/30-second cooldown even if the roll fails. No armored target means no cooldown.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.strong_arm.ca: Chance to break one random armor piece on an aimed enemy.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.crucible_hook: Hook the enemy you aim at within 20 blocks, pull it toward you and smash it upon reaching melee range. Damage: 1.25/1.5/1.75/2 times current weapon damage; burn: 3/4/5/6 seconds. Cooldown: 40/35/30/25 seconds. Blocks obstruct the hook; switching cancels it.
Pull an aimed enemy close, then smash and ignite it.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.nether_born: Deal 20% more melee and weapon-explosion damage while holding this weapon in the Nether. This passive has one level.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.nether_born.c: Deal 20% more weapon damage in the Nether.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.explosive_hit: Your next 10 successful melee hits create small blasts dealing 30% of your current weapon damage, without harming you or terrain. Radius: 1.5/2/2.5/3 blocks at levels I/II/III/IV. Cooldown: 45 seconds after the charges finish or are canceled by switching.
Ten hits explode for 30% weapon damage, without harming you.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.fire_resistan: Gain infinite Fire Resistance while holding this weapon in your main hand. Level II also works in the offhand and is the maximum level. Weapon protection ends when neither hand qualifies; other Fire Resistance effects keep their normal duration.
Fire Resistance while held; level II also protects from offhand.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.heating_up: Store half of melee damage taken as heat, up to 20. A successful attack spends 5 heat to ignite its affected enemies for 3/4/5/6 seconds. At level IV, remaining fire on you becomes heat and is extinguished unless capacity is already full. Switching clears heat.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.heating_up.ca: Store melee damage as heat; spend heat to ignite your attacks.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.cold_bellows: Successfully blocking damage with a shield ignites the attacker, including the shooter of a blocked projectile, for 3/4/5/6 seconds at levels I/II/III/IV. Hold this claymore in your main hand.
Shield blocks ignite the attacking enemy or projectile shooter.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.cinder_decoy: Leave an ember silhouette that attracts nearby hostile mobs for 6/8/10/12 seconds. Hostile contact or attacks detonate it, damaging and igniting nearby enemies for 3/4/5/6 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds after it ends. Switching cancels the decoy.
Leave an ember decoy; hostile contact detonates and ignites it.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.explosion: Gain Resistance IV for 2 seconds and unleash a creeper-strength explosion. Your own explosion does not hurt or knock you back and does not destroy terrain. Cooldown: 60/55/50/45 seconds at levels I/II/III/IV.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.explosion.car: Gain Resistance IV, then explode without harming yourself.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.quench_point: Successful melee hits extinguish burning enemies and store up to 10 seconds of their remaining fire for the next successful hit within 10 seconds. Each second adds 0.5/0.75/1/1.25 damage at levels I/II/III/IV. Switching weapons clears stored fire.
Quench a burning enemy; stored fire strengthens your next hit.
tooltips.forgermod.dagger.tooltip: A compact carbon steel blade made for quick, precise strikes.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.heading: Passives:
tooltips.forgermod.passive.revenge.name: Revenge
tooltips.forgermod.passive.dagger.name: Dual Wield
tooltips.forgermod.passive.axe.name: Vertical Strike
tooltips.forgermod.ability.leech.name: Leech
tooltips.forgermod.ability.heading: Active Abilities:
tooltips.forgermod.ability.flaming_combo: For 10 seconds, each dagger hit adds 1 second of burn (30-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.pyromaniac: While burning, arm your next dagger hit to ignite the target for 5 seconds and heal 5 HP (50-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.void_step: Teleport up to 10 blocks in your look direction, including into the air; up to 20 blocks with another Riftfang Dagger in your offhand (7-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.sudden_presen: Teleport behind the nearest hostile mob within 20 blocks (2-minute cooldown)
message.forgermod.ability.unavailable: Ability cannot be used right now
tooltips.forgermod.ability.absolute_nigh: Your next 2 dagger hits inflict Darkness I and Weakness I for 10 seconds (20-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.lucid_dreamin: Your next dagger kill against an enemy grants Speed II for 30 seconds and halves fall damage for the next 15 seconds (15-second cooldown)
message.forgermod.lucid.armed: Lucid Dreaming armed for your next enemy kill
tooltips.forgermod.ability.area_discharg: Strike every hostile mob within 5 blocks with lightning for half your current weapon damage; each lightning hit counts toward Charge Attack (30-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.charge_attack: Your next 20 mob hits each deal 5% more damage than the previous hit, reaching +100%; the 21st discharges 20 extra lightning damage (2-minute cooldown)
message.forgermod.charge_attack.armed: Charge Attack armed for 21 mob hits
tooltips.forgermod.passive.chain_lightni: Hits can chain up to 10 times, with a 50% chance per link. Each next hostile mob is within 10 blocks of the previous target and takes half your current weapon damage.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.eye_of_the_st: Whirl all entities except you within 10 blocks for 5 seconds; living targets are levitated (1-minute cooldown)
message.forgermod.eye_of_the_storm.activ: Eye of the Storm active for 5 seconds
tooltips.forgermod.ability.windy_dash: Launch yourself in your look direction; momentum, gravity and collisions determine the distance (5-second base cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.passive.double_jump: Press Jump again in midair after a normal jump to leap once more
tooltips.forgermod.ability.deep_wound: Your next critical dagger hit deals double damage and inflicts Slowness III on the target for 5 seconds (30-second cooldown)
message.forgermod.deep_wound.armed: Deep Wound armed for your next critical hit
tooltips.forgermod.ability.leech: Your next 10 dagger hits deal 10% more normal damage and heal you from that bonus, restoring at most 10 HP in total (15-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.rooting_roots: Hold hostile mobs within 10 blocks in place and poison them for 10 seconds (1-minute cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.ability.poisoned_vein: Your next dagger kill against a hostile mob leaves a 3-block poison cloud for 5 seconds, applying 30 seconds of Poison I to anyone inside, including you (45-second cooldown)
message.forgermod.poisoned_vein.armed: Poisoned Vein armed for your next hostile kill
tooltips.forgermod.ability.strengthened_: Your next dagger kill against a hostile mob makes you invulnerable for 10 seconds (90-second cooldown)
message.forgermod.strengthened_bones.arm: Strengthened Bones armed for your next hostile kill
tooltips.forgermod.ability.storing_anger: Deal no damage for 10 seconds; your next Morsium dagger hit releases all stored damage (1-minute cooldown)
message.forgermod.storing_anger.active: Storing Anger: damage is stored for 10 seconds
tooltips.forgermod.passive.death_march: Dagger damage rises as the target loses health, up to double damage
tooltips.forgermod.passive.revenge: Deal 20% more dagger damage to undead mobs
tooltips.forgermod.ability.sonic_crit: Your next critical dagger hit adds damage equal to 15% of the target's maximum health and releases a sonic boom (30-second cooldown)
message.forgermod.sonic_crit.armed: Sonically Charged Crit armed for your next critical hit
tooltips.forgermod.ability.sonic_boom: Fire a 50-block, 3x3 piercing sonic blast along your aim for twice your equipped attack damage; hits all entities except items, and only blocks along its center stop it (45-second cooldown)
tooltips.forgermod.passive.axe:
Every third attack within 10 seconds slams a 3×3 area ahead.
Requires an empty offhand.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.dagger: Daggers of the same material strike in both hands, including different gemstone variants; learned material hits apply their effect.
tooltips.forgermod.axe.tooltip:
§7A heavy carbon steel head balanced for
hard, deliberate strikes.§r
tooltips.forgermod.rusty_axe.tooltip:
§7Its edge has flaked away beneath years
of rust. Old forge marks remain on the
haft.

Can be restored.§r
tooltips.forgermod.rusty_dagger.tooltip:
§7A small blade dulled by rust. It once
belonged to someone who travelled light.

Can be restored.§r
tooltips.forgermod.verdant_axe.tooltip:
§7Roots from a Lush Cave wrap around
this axe, gripping its head as firmly
as any smith's binding.§r
tooltips.forgermod.ghost_axe.tooltip:
§7Bone and iron from the Soul Sand
Valleys form an axe that feels lighter
than it has any right to be.§r
tooltips.forgermod.molten_axe.tooltip:
§7Forged beside the lava seas of the
Nether, this axe still carries the heat
of its first fire.§r
tooltips.forgermod.nullified_axe.tooltip:
§7An axe shaped in the End's cold void.
Light seems to fade along its edge.§r
tooltips.forgermod.woundmaker_axe.toolti:
§7Crystallized blood from the undead
runs through its head. Old stains
never leave the blade.§r
tooltips.forgermod.dreamweaver_axe.toolt:
§7An axe imagined into being in a dream.
Its outline shifts whenever you look away.§r
tooltips.forgermod.echoing_axe.tooltip:
§7Sculk from the deepest dark lines this
axe. Every blow leaves a faint echo
in the silence.§r
tooltips.forgermod.voltage_axe.tooltip:
§7A lightning strike charged its
Electrium head. Sparks gather where
the blade meets the haft.§r
tooltips.forgermod.skybreaker_axe.toolti:
§7Refined by storms at great heights,
its Taifunite head cuts through the
air with a restless whistle.§r
tooltips.forgermod.leafcutter_dagger.too:
§7A slim blade threaded with Lush Cave
vines. Its edge parts leaves without
slowing the hand that holds it.§r
tooltips.forgermod.deathwisper_dagger.to:
§7Bone remnants from the Soul Sand
Valleys give this pale dagger an
unsettling, whisper-quiet edge.§r
tooltips.forgermod.emberfang_dagger.tool:
§7A short Nether-forged blade that
still glows like an ember beneath
its darkened surface.§r
tooltips.forgermod.riftfang_dagger.toolt:
§7A sliver of the End's void shaped into
a dagger. Its edge seems to end beyond
where you can see it.§r
tooltips.forgermod.assassin_dagger.toolt:
§7Undead blood has crystallized along
this narrow blade. Its dark red edge
is made for a quick, close strike.§r
tooltips.forgermod.nightmare_dagger.tool:
§7A dagger born from a troubled dream.
Even awake, its shape is difficult
to remember clearly.§r
tooltips.forgermod.wardens_needle.toolti:
§7A sculk-tipped needle from the deepest
dark. Its narrow point is almost lost
against the shadows around it.§r
tooltips.forgermod.static_dagger.tooltip:
§7Lightning left a restless charge in
this small Electrium blade. Tiny
sparks dance along its edge.§r
tooltips.forgermod.dead_calm_dagger.tool:
§7A Taifunite dagger honed by high
winds. The air goes strangely still
just before it moves.§r
tooltips.forgermod.augment_template.tool: Store abilities at an Augmentation Table or Blaze Enchanter. Transfer compatible abilities in an anvil or Blaze Forger.
tooltips.forgermod.super_augment_templat: Stores abilities one rank above their normal limit. Use an Augmentation Table or a supercharged Blaze Enchanter; transfer them in an anvil or supercharged Blaze Forger.
augmentation.forgermod.material_hit.name: Material Hit
tooltips.forgermod.augment_template.mate: Applies the receiving weapon's material effect on hit.
tooltips.forgermod.gemstone_upgrade_temp:
§7This template is used to infuse weapons
with gemstones increasing specific weapon stats.

Infuse your weapons at the Infusion Table!§r
tooltips.forgermod.ancient_upgrade_templ:
§7This template is used to forge advanced
weapons like claymores.

Forge weapons in the Forge!§r
tooltips.forgermod.claymore.tooltip:
§7A long Sword made from the best
Materials you found on your adventures.

Can be upgraded with every
§r§dsupreme Material.§r
tooltips.forgermod.rusty_claymore.toolti:
§7It looks like a claymore, but it's
extremely rusty, it barely even cuts
through grass. It must have been forged
hundreds of years ago.

Can be restored.§r
tooltips.forgermod.infernal_claymore.too:
§7A blazing claymore usually found in
ancient nether structures, made by
the ancients.§r
§7A dark and cool-looking claymore usually
found in the end, deep in the void.§r
tooltips.forgermod.overgrown_claymore.to:
§7A very old claymore which must have
been in a lush cave for a very long
time.§r
tooltips.forgermod.hollow_claymore.toolt:
§7A claymore reinforced by bones from
the enemies it killed. A truly scary
sword to possess.§r
tooltips.forgermod.curseblood_claymore.t:
§7A bloody claymore cursed by all the
enemies it defeated. It's being said
that it belonged to a psychopath long
ago.§r
tooltips.forgermod.dreambound_claymore.t:
§7A claymore sending enemies to eternal
rest. A claymore known as deadly as
death itself, and often used for killing
people while they are asleep.§r
tooltips.forgermod.shrieking_claymore.to:
§7A claymore found in the deepest depths,
reinforced with sculk, a material
from another dimension.§r
tooltips.forgermod.claymore_of_thunder.t:
§7A claymore charged by the might of
lightning, 1,000,000 volts of electricity
flow through this blade electrifying
everyone coming too close.§r
tooltips.forgermod.storming_claymore.too:
§7A claymore found at high altitudes, due
to the high wind speeds blowing everything
away.§r
tooltips.forgermod.inanisium_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material found in the void,
where nothing else is able to exist.§r
tooltips.forgermod.ignisium_ingot.toolti:
§7A supreme material found deep in the
nether, mostly submerged in lava
and magma.§r
tooltips.forgermod.pulsite_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material found in the deepest
depths, in a very dark environment.§r
tooltips.forgermod.somnium_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material that can only be
imagined. It may appear in your 
dreams.§r
tooltips.forgermod.vulnusium_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material found deep in the flesh of undead monsters, where blood
crystallizes to a very strong material.§r
tooltips.forgermod.morsium_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material found deep in the
Soulsand Valleys, mostly under a pile
of bones and remnants.§r
tooltips.forgermod.lush_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material found mostly in
Lush Caves, where plants are 
thriving, and new live emerges.§r
tooltips.forgermod.electrium_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material charged up by a
highly energized lightning strike, it 
is said that it's the secret behind the creeper's
ability to charge up.§r
tooltips.forgermod.taifunite_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material refined by endless storms and
strong winds blowing on high
altitudes.§r
tooltips.forgermod.developium_ingot.tool:
§7A supreme material made up by the
genius (BananasHelp20), who made the
mod, in cooperation with
ALLESBANANE11§r

§dCreative only!§r
tooltips.forgermod.carbon_steel_cross_gu:
§7A good sword needs a cross guard,
protecting the owner from hits of
enemies.§r
tooltips.forgermod.sharpened_blade.toolt:
§7A blade sharpened till all of the
fingers bleed, the smith of this
blade must have been extremely
focused on sharpening the blade.§r
tooltips.forgermod.handle.tooltip:
§7This handle is used for more advanced
weapons, than the regular ones.
It's very stable and way harder
than a simple stick.§r
tooltips.forgermod.advanced_handle.toolt:
§7This handle is used for the best
weapons imaginable, extremely stable,
and very comfortable to hold.§r
tooltips.forgermod.amethyst.tooltip:
§7A very dense and fine variant of the
amethyst found in geodes, it's absolutely
flawless.

When applied to a Weapon:§r
§5+0.4 Attack Speed§r
tooltips.forgermod.amber.tooltip:
§7It burns your finger upon touching it.
It's a flawless, yet extremely hot stone
and you've never seen something like it
before.

When applied to a Weapon:
§r§6makes item fire resistant§r
tooltips.forgermod.ruby.tooltip:
§7A sharp and edgy stone. It's shining
as red as the blood your enemies
bleed when killed with a very sharp
weapon.

When applied to a Weapon:§r
§4+1 Damage§r
tooltips.forgermod.jade.tooltip:
§7A very precious jewel, which gives you
the feeling that it could bring up the true
potential of any supreme weapon.

When applied to a Weapon:§r
§2+1 Effect Amplifier
+1 Second Effect Duration§r
tooltips.forgermod.amber.tooltip_extra:
§7
Gemstone: [§r§6Amber§r§7]
Gemstone bonus:§r§6
Item fire resistance§r
tooltips.forgermod.jade.tooltip_extra:
§7
Gemstone: [§r§2Jade§r§7]
Gemstone bonus:§r
§2+1 Effect Amplifier
+1 Second Effect Duration§r

commands.forgermod.cooldown.usage: Usage: /no-ability-cooldown <player or selector> <true|false>. For yourself: /no-ability-cooldown @s true
commands.forgermod.cooldown.permission: This command requires cheats or operator permission (level 2). In singleplayer, enable cheats; on a server, ask an operator.

tooltips.forgermod.ability.swap_hint: Shift + Alt + S swaps your primary and secondary abilities
tooltips.forgermod.ability.always_the_ga: Arm your next enemy kill for 60 seconds. It leaves a plant and a poison cloud for five minutes. Everyone in the cloud, including you and allies, receives Poison I for 20 seconds. Radius: 2/2.5/3/3.5 blocks. Switching cancels the garden. Cooldown after ending: 60/50/40/30 seconds.
Your next enemy kill plants a five-minute poison cloud. Affects everyone for 20 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.grave_vault: Crouch-right-click to open nine flower storage slots inside this weapon. Right-click terrain to place the first flower that can grow there. Stored flowers persist on this weapon; normal placement rules and permissions apply.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.grave_vault.c: Store flowers in nine slots. Right-click suitable terrain to plant them.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.echo_pin.name: Echo Hearing
tooltips.forgermod.ability.echo_pin: Reveal every nearby entity, including players, through walls within 32/40/48/56 blocks. Glowing lasts 10/12/14/16 seconds. Cooldown: 30/25/20/15 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.echo_pin.card: Reveal all nearby entities, including players, through walls for 10/12/14/16 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.warden_tone: While holding this weapon, your actions and owned projectiles make no detectable sculk vibrations. Taking damage remains detectable. Other entities and sounds remain unaffected.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.warden_tone.c: Suppress your sculk vibrations while holding this weapon. Taking damage still reveals you.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.echo_salvage: A vertical strike that misses living targets but strikes solid ground or a wall stores one echo for 30 seconds. Your next vertical strike that successfully hits an enemy consumes it, adding half your weapon damage, capped at 2/4/6/8 bonus damage. Echoes do not stack; ordinary attacks and circular swings do not consume them. Switching clears the echo.
A missed vertical strike stores an echo. Your next successful vertical strike releases capped bonus damage.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.flame_breath: Breathe a 35-degree fire cone in your look direction, dealing current weapon damage and burning enemies for 3/4/5/6 seconds. Range: 4/5/6/7 blocks; cooldown: 30/25/20/15 seconds. Blocks stop the breath.
Breathe a short fire cone, damaging and igniting enemies ahead.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.charred_edge: Deal 15% more melee damage to enemies with Fire Resistance. Maximum level: I.
Deal 15% more melee damage to enemies with Fire Resistance.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.magma_toss: Throw a molten rock that bursts on the first enemy or solid block, dealing current weapon damage and igniting nearby enemies. Radius: 2/2.5/3/3.5 blocks; burn: 3/4/5/6 seconds. Projectile lasts up to 3 seconds. Cooldown after ending: 35/30/25/20 seconds. Blocks stop blast damage; terrain and allies are safe.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.magma_toss.ca: Throw a molten rock that bursts on impact, damaging and igniting nearby enemies.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.displace.name: Displace
tooltips.forgermod.ability.displace: Swap places with the visible enemy under your crosshair within 10 blocks. Both bodies must fit in clear, loaded, dry destinations; mounted entities cannot swap. Cooldown: 40/35/30/25 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.displace.card: Swap places with a visible aimed enemy within ten blocks if both destinations are clear.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.backstab.name: Backstab
tooltips.forgermod.passive.backstab: Deal 20% more melee damage when striking an enemy from behind, within 60 degrees of directly behind it. Maximum level: I.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.backstab.card: Deal 20% more melee damage when striking an enemy from behind.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.void_grip: Your melee hits produce 25% less knockback, keeping enemies within dagger reach. Maximum level: I.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.void_grip.car: Your melee hits produce 25% less knockback.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.void_pulse: Release a damage-free pulse that pushes visible enemies away. Radius: 4/5/6/7 blocks; knockback strength: 0.6/0.8/1/1.2. Cooldown: 30/25/20/15 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.void_pulse.ca: Push nearby enemies away without dealing damage.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.gravity_well: Pull visible enemies within six blocks toward you with one burst of velocity. A visual smash plays when a pulled enemy reaches melee range; it deals weapon damage. The pull itself deals no damage. Pull strength: 0.6/0.7/0.8/0.9. Ends after arrival or two seconds; switching cancels. Cooldown after ending: 40/35/30/25 seconds.
Pull enemies within six blocks toward you; a weapon-damage smash plays on arrival.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.lonely_dream: Gain 5% attack speed for each enemy within ten blocks while holding this weapon. The bonus updates as enemies enter or leave and ends when you switch weapons. Maximum level: I.
Gain 5% attack speed for each enemy within ten blocks.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.unfinished_dr: Killing an enemy before it damages you heals one health point, equal to half a heart. Hits absorbed by absorption health still count. Maximum level: I.
Killing an enemy before it hits you heals half a heart.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.just_a_dream: Teleport safely to your respawn point, including across dimensions. Missing beds or anchors fall back to world spawn. Does not consume respawn-anchor charges. Mounted use is rejected. Cooldown: 60/50/40/30 seconds.
Teleport safely to your respawn point, even in another dimension.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.sleepwalker: Deal 10% more melee damage at night in dimensions with a day-night cycle. Night is between world times 13000 and 23000; storms during daytime do not count. Maximum level: I.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.sleepwalker.c: Deal 10% more melee damage at night.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.lullaby.name: Lullaby
tooltips.forgermod.ability.lullaby: Put the aimed enemy within 10/12/14/16 blocks to sleep for three seconds. Sleeping mobs cannot move or attack; damage wakes them immediately. Players instead receive Slowness II for three seconds. Switching cancels sleep. Cooldown: 40/35/30/25 seconds after sleep ends.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.lullaby.card: Sleep an aimed mob for three seconds; damage wakes it. Players receive brief Slowness.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.dream_feast: Restore eight hunger points (four food icons), capped at full hunger. Adds no saturation. Cooldown: 60/50/40/30 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.daydreamer: Gain Jump Boost I while holding this axe in your main hand during daytime. Ends when you put it away or night begins. Stronger potion effects are preserved.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.daydreamer.ca: Gain Jump Boost I while holding the axe during daytime.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.pillow_armor: Take 25% less fall damage while holding this axe in your main hand.
Take 25% less fall damage while holding the axe.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.magnetic_thro: Launch the aimed enemy within melee reach along your look direction with velocity 1.1/1.3/1.5/1.7. Walls block targeting; adds no damage or teleportation. Cooldown: 25/20/15/10 seconds.
Launch an enemy within melee reach along your look direction.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.live_wire: For eight seconds, enemies that successfully hit you in melee receive two damage in return. Reflected damage cannot reflect again. Switching weapons cancels. Cooldown after ending: 40/35/30/25 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.live_wire.car: For eight seconds, reflect two damage to melee attackers.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.quick_recharg: A successful fully charged critical hit shortens this weapon variant's primary ability cooldown by one second. Can trigger once every two seconds. Does not change the secondary cooldown.
Charged critical hits shorten the primary cooldown by one second, once every two seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.conductive_ed: Deal 20% more melee damage to enemies standing in water or exposed to rain.
Deal 20% more melee damage to wet enemies.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.static_blade: Arm the next swing for up to 30 seconds. It releases a four-block-wide, half-block-high echo along your look direction at that swing, traveling 20 blocks and dealing current weapon damage once to each enemy. Solid blocks stop it. Switching cancels. Cooldown after ending: 40/35/30/25 seconds.
Your next swing releases a wide piercing blade echo for 20 blocks; walls stop it.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.lightning_rod: While holding this weapon, lightning cannot hurt or ignite you. Extra harmless strikes can occur under open sky without a storm (average once per minute). A strike grants five absorption hearts and Strength I for 30 seconds; repeated strikes replenish those five hearts without stacking. Putting the weapon away ends these buffs.
Lightning is harmless and grants five absorption hearts plus Strength I; extra strikes need no storm.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.alternating_c: Arm a hit for up to 30 seconds. Hitting an enemy with another visible enemy within 20 blocks starts a one-minute link: the second enemy is stunned for 0.1 seconds immediately, then the stun alternates every second. Stuns add no damage. The link ends if targets die, separate by more than 20 blocks, or you switch weapons. Walls block pulses. Cooldown after ending: 120/100/80/60 seconds.
Link two enemies within 20 blocks; a harmless stun alternates every second for one minute.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.direct_curren: Arm marking for 30 seconds. Melee-hit 2/3/4/4 different enemies, each within 50 blocks of every other mark. At two marks, stun the anchors and form barriers for 20 seconds; another mark refreshes that duration. Crossing a visible barrier deals two hearts of damage, at most once per half-second. Rank IV becomes Static Field: at three marks, all living entities inside their triangle take one damage per second. Walls block barriers and field formation. Switching or anchor death cancels. Cooldown after ending: 120/100/80/60 seconds.
Mark enemies to stun them and form damaging barriers. Rank IV adds a field that also hurts you and allies.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.stunning_pres: For 30 seconds, visible enemies within 4/6/8/10 blocks take one damage and are stunned for 0.3 seconds per pulse. Pulses occur every 2/1.65/1.35/1 seconds. Switching cancels. Cooldown after ending: 60/50/40/30 seconds.
For 30 seconds, repeatedly damage and briefly stun nearby enemies.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.heavy_current: Deal 15% more melee damage to enemies wearing armor in all four normal armor slots.
Deal 15% more melee damage to fully armored enemies.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.downdraft_bel: Force visible airborne enemies within 4/6/8/10 blocks downward once, with minimum downward velocity 0.8/1.0/1.2/1.4. Grounded and swimming enemies are unaffected. Adds no damage or teleportation and preserves horizontal momentum and existing fall distance. Cooldown: 30/25/20/15 seconds.
Force airborne enemies downward once; grounded enemies are unaffected.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.crosswind: For two minutes, incoming projectiles are deflected sideways to miss you while preserving their speed. Your own shots are unaffected. Switching weapons cancels protection. Cooldown after ending: 180/160/140/120 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.crosswind.car: Deflect incoming projectiles for two minutes.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.slipstream: While sprinting directly behind a moving ally within three blocks and in clear sight, gain 10% base movement speed. The bonus ends when you stop, overtake, turn away, lose sight, or put the dagger away. Does not stack.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.slipstream.ca: Sprint behind a moving ally to gain a small speed bonus.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.upwind.name: Upwind
tooltips.forgermod.ability.upwind: Arm your next successful melee hit for up to 30 seconds. After normal hit knockback, add 0.6/0.8/1.0/1.2 knockback and launch the enemy upward at velocity 0.6/0.8/1.0/1.2, respecting knockback resistance. Adds no direct damage. Switching cancels. Cooldown after the hit: 30/25/20/15 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.upwind.card: Your next melee hit adds knockback and launches the enemy upward.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.windcharge: Launch upward about 5/10/15/20 blocks (axes: 10/16/23/30). Axe rank IV becomes Skybreaker: falling hits or ground landings smash enemies within 2 blocks with weapon damage plus mace fall damage.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.windcharge.ca: Launch upward; axe rank IV gains a falling area smash.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.vacuum_burst: Pull dropped items and experience orbs within 6/8/10/12 blocks toward you with one gust. Normal pickup rules still apply.
Pull nearby drops and experience toward you.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.headwind.name: Headwind
tooltips.forgermod.passive.headwind: Sprinting uses half the normal hunger exhaustion while this weapon is held.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.feather_shelt: Grant yourself and allies within 4/6/8/10 blocks Slow Falling for 10 seconds.
Give yourself and nearby allies 10 seconds of Slow Falling.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.pocket_storm: Your next melee hit smashes enemies within 3 blocks for weapon damage and strong knockback. The original victim receives knockback without a second damage hit.
Arm a melee hit to create an area smash with strong knockback.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.blood_rush: Spend 2 health points to gain Speed II for 10 seconds. Cannot be used if the cost would kill you.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.blood_rush.ca: Spend 2 health points for 10 seconds of Speed II.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.final_strike: Deal 50% more melee damage to your most recently hit enemy when it has less than 10% health.
Deal 50% more damage to your last hit enemy below 10% health.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.blood_sacrafi: Sacrifice half your health and absorption to deal double weapon damage for 20 seconds. Switching weapons ends the effect.
Sacrifice half your health and absorption for 20 seconds of double damage.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.scar_compass: Your most recently hit enemy glows for 10 minutes, until you hit another enemy or stop holding this weapon.
Mark your most recently hit enemy with a 10-minute glow.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.revengeful_ex: Dying to an enemy releases a blood explosion for weapon damage within 5 blocks, plus 5 times weapon damage to your killer. Does not destroy blocks.
On death, damage nearby entities and deal 5 times weapon damage to your killer.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.sunfed.name: Sunfed
tooltips.forgermod.passive.sunfed: While holding this weapon outside in daylight, restore 1 hunger point every 15 seconds. Does not add saturation.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.sunfed.card: Restore 1 hunger every 15 seconds outside in daylight.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.photosynthesi: Restore 1 weapon durability every 15 seconds during daylight while this weapon is held.
Slowly repair this weapon while holding it during daylight.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.green_feast: Consume 1 wheat from your inventory to restore 2 health points. Requires missing health.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.green_feast.c: Consume 1 wheat to heal 2 health points.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.sapling_harve: Enemy kills have a 15% chance to drop 1 extra random sapling.
Enemy kills may drop an extra sapling (15% chance).
tooltips.forgermod.passive.compost.name: Compost
tooltips.forgermod.passive.compost: Eating rotten flesh while holding this weapon in either hand does not apply Hunger. Existing Hunger and other sources are unaffected.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.compost.card: Eat rotten flesh without its Hunger effect.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.lumberjack: Breaking logs with this axe does not consume weapon durability.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.lumberjack.ca: Mine logs without using weapon durability.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.ghostwalk: Gain Invisibility for 10 seconds. Attacking ends it; worn armor stays visible.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.ghostwalk.car: Become invisible for 10 seconds, until you attack.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.soul_hunger: Enemy kills grant 2 absorption health points, capped at 6 from this passive. Putting the weapon away removes its remaining absorption.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.soul_hunger.c: Enemy kills grant 2 absorption health, up to 6.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.last_stand: Once every 2 minutes, a fatal hit leaves you at 1 health point instead. Requires more than 1 health point before the hit.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.last_stand.ca: Survive a fatal hit at 1 HP, once every 2 minutes.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.bone_guard: Summon one friendly skeleton for 15 seconds. It shoots nearby enemies, drops no items or experience, and disappears when you put the weapon away.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.bone_guard.ca: Summon a friendly skeleton for 15 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.skull_throw: Fire a slow wither skull. Its first impact bursts for weapon damage and Wither I for 5 seconds against nearby enemies, without breaking blocks.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.skull_throw.c: A slow skull bursts for weapon damage and brief Wither.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.deaths_due: Enemy kills grant 25% more experience, rounded down to whole points. Item drops are unchanged.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.echo_appetite: Breaking sculk, sculk veins, sensors, catalysts or shriekers restores half a drumstick. Killing a Warden restores two drumsticks. Neither adds saturation.
Break sculk blocks for half a drumstick; defeat a Warden for two drumsticks.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.resonance_cri: Fully charged melee hits against rising, jumping enemies are critical hits, even while you stand on the ground.
Fully charged hits critically strike jumping enemies.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.aftershock: Each fully charged melee hit echoes for one damage point after one second. Echoes cannot trigger hit abilities or another echo; putting the weapon away cancels them.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.aftershock.ca: Charged melee hits echo for one damage after one second.
death.attack.forgermod.aftershock: %1$s was silenced by an aftershock from %2$s
death.attack.forgermod.aftershock.player: %1$s was silenced by an aftershock from %2$s
tooltips.forgermod.ability.ringing_steel: Arm your next successful melee hit for up to 30 seconds. It also deals 15 durability damage to the victim's held weapon, respecting normal durability enchantments. Armor and shields are unaffected.
Your next hit damages the enemy's held weapon by 15 durability.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.stone_song: Gain two armor points while holding this blade below Y=0.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.stone_song.ca: Holding this blade below Y=0 grants two armor points.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.challenge_roa: Roar to make hostile mobs within 16/20/24/28 blocks target you, even through walls. Players, allies and neutral creatures are unaffected. Cooldown: 30/25/20/15 seconds.
Hostile mobs within 16/20/24/28 blocks target you, even through walls.
